Using polars to do basic corpus searching


```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:20.928976Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:20.152007Z'}
import polars as pl
import polars.selectors as cs
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import os
from pathlib import Path

pl.Config.set_float_precision(2)
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:25.102252Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:25.076316Z'}

great_docs_root = Path(os.environ["QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR"])
repo_root = great_docs_root.parent

c = pl.read_parquet(data_file)
c.head(10)
```

## Token frequency

### Absolute frequency

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:29.005717Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:28.958903Z'}
abs_freq = c["token"].value_counts(sort=True)
abs_freq.head()
```

### Relative frequency

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:32.690485Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:32.637192Z'}
rel_freq = (
    c["token"]
    .value_counts(normalize=True, sort=True)
    .with_columns(pl.col("proportion") * 100000)
)
rel_freq.head()
```

### Zipf's Law

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:40.112741Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:39.980982Z'}
zipf = (
    c["token"]
    .str.to_lowercase()
    .value_counts(sort=True)
    .with_row_index("rank", offset=1)
)
sns.lineplot(data=zipf.head(50), x="rank", y="count")
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:43.214918Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:19:42.983125Z'}
plt.loglog()
sns.lineplot(data=zipf, x="rank", y="count")
```

## Dispersion

### Range

$$\mbox{range}=\mbox{no. of parts with word $w$}$$

$$\mbox{range}\%=\frac{\mbox{no. of parts with word $w$}}{\mbox{total no. of parts in the corpus}}\times 100$$

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:20:29.773697Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:20:29.715641Z'}
n_file_ids = c.select(pl.col("file_id").n_unique()).item()
r2 = (
    c.group_by(pl.col("token").str.to_lowercase())
    .agg((pl.col("file_id").n_unique() / n_file_ids * 100).alias("r2"))
    .sort(by="r2", descending=True)
)
r2.head(10)
```

### Standard deviation

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:58:39.284135Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:58:39.244420Z'}
std_dev = c.group_by('file_id').agg(pl.col('token').value_counts(normalize=True).alias('c')) \
    .explode('c') \
    .select(pl.col("c").struct.unnest()) \
    .with_columns(pl.col('proportion') * 100000) \
    .group_by('token') \
    .agg((pl.col('proportion').sum()**2).alias('s1'),
        (pl.col('proportion')**2).sum().alias('s2')) \
    .with_columns(((n_file_ids*pl.col('s2')-pl.col('s1')).sqrt()/n_file_ids).alias('sigma')) \
   .sort(by='sigma', descending=True)

    #.with_columns((pl.col('s2')-pl.col('s1')).sqrt().alias('sigma')) \
#    .sort(by='sigma', descending=False)

std_dev.head(10)
```

### Coefficient of variation

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2026-06-15T17:59:13.170848Z', start_time: '2026-06-15T17:59:13.130898Z'}
cv = c.group_by('file_id').agg(pl.col('token').value_counts(normalize=True).alias('c')) \
    .explode('c') \
    .select(pl.col("c").struct.unnest()) \
    .with_columns(pl.col('proportion') * 100000) \
    .group_by('token') \
    .agg(pl.col('proportion').mean().alias('mean')) \
    .join(std_dev, on='token') \
    .with_columns((pl.col('sigma')/pl.col('mean')).alias('cv')) \
    .sort(by='cv', descending=True)
cv
```

### Juliand's *D*


### DP (Deviation of Proportions)


Brezina pg. 26




```{python}
the = (
    c
    .group_by("file_id")
    .agg(
        (
            pl.col("lemma").len().alias("n"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "the").sum().alias("the"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "i").sum().alias("i"),
            (pl.col("lemma") == "you").sum().alias("you"),
        )
    )
    .select("file_id", (cs.numeric().exclude("n") / pl.col("n") * 10000))
    .sort(by="file_id")
)

the.head(10)
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:14.243100Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:14.036165Z'}
```


```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.113950Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:17.287934Z'}
hits = c.filter(
    pl.col("lemma").is_in(["very", "really", "rather", "quite"]), pl.col("tag") == "AV0"
)
counts = (
    hits.group_by("lemma", "text_type")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("count"))
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("count") / pl.col("count").sum().over("text_type") * 100).alias("pct")
    )
)
counts
```

```{python}
#| ExecuteTime: {end_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.785974Z', start_time: '2025-09-25T18:09:18.682773Z'}
hits = c.filter(pl.col("lemma").is_in(["very", "really"]))

ratio = (
    hits.group_by("text_type")
    .agg(
        ((pl.col("token") == "very").sum() / (pl.col("token") == "really").sum()).alias(
            "ratio"
        )
    )
    .sort(by="ratio")
)
ratio
```
